source: V20 (Luc's playtest of 13 Nov 2026, luc_notes/2026-11-13_playtest/s01-s20): 13 checkpoints on the places Luc chose, in driving order; Unity axes (x east, z north). The export and pin_checkpoints.py put each checkpoint on the route point nearest to its anchor (order along the lap checked). 'width' = trigger width across the road in metres (track.json checkpoint_widths; CampusWorldBuilder.AddRaceParts, fallback road width + 4 m). 'v20_index' = the index in the final track.json (after hall_route.py and hall_join.py) when the anchors were set. Before V20: 12 checkpoints on Noah's places of role3/V9-world-look (d2cae87).
